'''Liquid hydrogen''' was the liquid form of the element [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]]. When enriched with [[Tritium]], it was used as cheap reactor [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]].<ref name="rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
